title: Trebuchim - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Trebuchim in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Trebuchim is a lightning-element weapon used by Lune. It scales with Vitality (A), Luck (B).

sections.title: How to Get the Trebuchim
sections.content:
Location: Ancient Sanctuary - Catapult Sakapatate drop.

Obtained from Ancient Sanctuary - Catapult Sakapatate drop.

sections.title: Is the Trebuchim Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (A), Luck (B). A dedicated lightning pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
